description: A field of arrows on linear axes: each arrow sits on its x, y point and points the way its u (across) and v (up) numbers say, with a length in proportion to the size of the vector. Use it for wind, flow, forces or any vector field. The axes come from d3 nice() and ticks() (d3-scale's linear scale), computed on the server, so there is no script. Arrows are centred on their point, drawn at a fixed size scale so the longest is a set length, and an arrow of length 0 is a dot. A hidden table gives every arrow's x, y, across, up and length. Static, settled picture; each arrow fades in through --k from --p (build progress 0 to 1, default 1).
